test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 5 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: According to the Census of India 2011, what is the percentage of the urban population?
solution:
The correct answer is __**31.16%.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The size of urbanization grow from** 27.81 per cent in the 2001 Census to 31.16 per cent in the 2011 Census.**
 
• While the percentage of rural population decreased from **72.19 per cent to 68.84 per cent.**
 
• India urban population for **2021 was 493,169,259, a 2.32% **
